integrity: Mathematical proof uses a classification of all root-directed arborescences and the classical BEST theorem. Finite independent computations cover n=2..11; they are not used to extrapolate the proof.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet, exact Hamming-weight interval {1,2}, n>=2, cyclic rotation quotient only; no claim of reversal/complement equivalence or other weight intervals. Residual priority risk of implicit older tree-count enumeration.
title: Exactly \(2^{\lfloor(n-1)/2\rfloor}\) weight-one/two universal cycles
